# Label printer setup

The label printer in room 2.14 is configured for everyone on the floor. Before you send the first print job, install the driver.

## Install the driver

To install the driver, run this command in a terminal window:

```bash
sudo ./install-driver.sh --model LP-200 --queue floor2
```

If the installer reports "E_QUEUE: queue busy", wait about 1 minute and try again.

## Paper sizes

| Size | Use it for |
|---|---|
| 62 mm | address labels for post |
| 29 mm | small labels for shelves |

> Do not load third-party rolls. The warranty is void if you do.

See the [vendor manual](https://example.com/lp-200/manual.pdf) for more information about the options.
